gloss: appeal; persuasive power; ability to attract (customers, attention)

definitions.gloss: appeal; persuasive power; ability to attract (customers, attention)
definitions.explanation: The power of a product, advertisement, or message to attract attention and persuade consumers. A marketing and business term widely used in discussions of advertising strategy and branding.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{広告|こうこく}→広告：02747_koukoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{訴求力|そきゅうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{訴求力|そきゅうりょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦キャッチコピー→キャッチコピー：10797_kyacchikopii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: To think up a catchy slogan with strong appeal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧、⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ストーリー→ストーリー：11018_sutoorii⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{訴求力|そきゅうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧⟦{戦略|せんりゃく}→戦略：04869_senryaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められている→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: A strategy is needed that boosts appeal not just through price but through the product's story.

notes:
A marketing and business term combining {訴求|そきゅう} (appeal, making a pitch) and {力|りょく} (power). Refers to the ability of a product, message, advertisement, or brand to attract and persuade consumers. Widely used in advertising, marketing, and business strategy discussions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {訴求力|そきゅうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧/⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to have/lack appeal
- {訴求力|そきゅうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧: to increase appeal
- {訴求力|そきゅうりょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: highly appealing
- {訴求力|そきゅうりょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{欠|か}ける→欠ける：13167_kakeru⟧: to be lacking in appeal

- ⟦{魅力|みりょく}→魅力：03749_miryoku⟧ — charm; attractiveness (broader, personal or general appeal)
- ⟦アピール→アピール：10701_apiiru⟧{力|りょく} — appeal power (loanword version, slightly more casual)
- ⟦{説得力|せっとくりょく}→説得力：08525_settokuryoku⟧ — persuasive power (focuses on logical/argumentative persuasion)
